title: The Unmapped Underground Return

features.name: the river that refuses to be charted
features.desc-on-touch: every map of it contradicts the last; channels shift between readings; the current remembers the water's path before it was born

features.name: the archive's failed surveys
features.desc-on-touch: stacked charts and drawings; each one proves the others wrong; the contradiction is the truest map

features.name: the stone that held three channels
features.desc-on-touch: water flows around it in three directions at once; each flow is the true return; the stone does not know which

features.name: dense records of the return
features.desc-on-touch: calculations of flow, sketches of emergence, coded notations the archive uses to hold the river still while it reads

features.name: the remembering current
features.desc-on-touch: water touches this chamber and suddenly recalls every place it has ever been; the memory makes it younger

features.name: the transceiver buried in sediment
features.desc-on-touch: broadcasts nothing; receives the underground's own transmission; the river learns what it sounds like from below

inscription: to map is to kill the unmappable; the river taught the archive this by flowing between the lines of every chart

file.name: Underground_Surveys_Contradictory_Complete.txt
file.note: six independent surveys of the same underground channel; six different results; each mathematically sound; error found in what is meant by location
